summary: In an event stream's Headers field, * includes all headers except X-Envoy*, X-Trusted-Proxy, X-Forwarded-For and X-Real-Id, with Authorization redacted; a comma list like Host,Authorization,X-Request-ID includes only those; empty means no headers in Production or Test mode.
questions: How do I include HTTP headers in event stream payloads?
Why are no headers in my event payload?
Which headers are excluded when I use * for event stream headers?
Is the Authorization header redacted in event streams?

answer_card.title: Event stream Headers field
answer_card.answer_md:
- `*`: all headers, except those starting with `X-Envoy`, `X-Trusted-Proxy`, `X-Forwarded-For`, `X-Real-Id`; `Authorization` is shown as `Redacted`.
- `Host,Authorization,X-Request-ID`: only the listed headers.
- Empty: **no** headers are added, in Production or Test mode.
